inspection.method: Opened local rendered reader in background Codex browser using cua. Read complete DOM text and inspected 15 sequential overlapping viewport screenshots from heading to final refinement note, scrolling 0.65–0.85 pages at a time. Inspected each entire embedded image across overlapping views and its adjacent paragraphs. Read complete Markdown and original source separately.
inspection.coverage: Entire primary, all three illustrations, provenance and refinement notes; no meaningful alternative exists. No alternate was inferred from historical source wording.
inspection.layout: Readable paragraph spacing and dialogue pauses; illustrations follow complete beats without splitting attribution. Wide images remain within reader margins; image02 spans a viewport but overlapping views expose all of it.

observations.humor_timing: Bone distraction now visibly defeats Neet’s own blockade; Buddy stops sneezing before landing. Peanut-butter correction and lip lick puncture investigative certainty. Heather’s feet question pays off Kulfi’s nap. Buddy’s Go on without me follows a concrete belly-rub reward; trying another patch after three steps carries that discovery forward. The last line pays off his effort-saving preference.
observations.voices_agency: Neet’s official protocols and grievance conceal a recognizable need for reassurance. Buddy chooses pantry, tests protest, then learns attention need not require collapse. Heather participates through distraction, dry feet remark, window patience and walking limit. Sagar stays restrained and resolves through familiar touch.
observations.cause_effect: Keys cause alarm, bones allow departure, Kulfi marks socks, socks trigger investigation and rolling protest, Heather rewards Buddy’s imitation, and that reward motivates outdoor retesting. Neet chooses to return his head when the scratch stops; forgiveness precedes lap return.
observations.emotion: The ear kept toward Heather punctures the sulk tenderly. There’s still room for you affirms belonging without excluding other dogs. Home lap and Buddy’s ordinary chest rub earn distinct warm endings; suspicious feet glance preserves Neet’s theatricality.
observations.complementary_art: Setup alarm, close floor-level evidence inspection and open-air reassurance vary viewpoint, object focus, lighting and emotional role. All three match exact current action states; none repeats the same portrait or spoils a later incident.
observations.source_comparison: Original key/skid, blockade/bones, pantry, Kulfi feet nap/three turns, scent protest, window sulk, walk collapses, ear scratch, lap and final foot suspicion survive. Current Buddy agency replaces original dim-observer framing coherently; source remains recoverable. No competing primary or meaningful alternative found.
